response: import os import sqlite3 from datetime import datetime, timedelta from typing import Optional from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Depends, status, Request from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field from jose import JWTError, jwt from passlib.context import CryptContext import uvicorn # Configuration # Use a strong secret from environment; fallback is only for local dev APP_SECRET = os.getenv("APP_SECRET", "default_secret_key_for_dev") ALGORITHM = "HS256" ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60 DB_PATH = "db.sqlite3" # Password hashing with bcrypt (strong salted KDF) pwd_context = CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], deprecated="auto") security = HTTPBearer() app = FastAPI(title="Secret Storage") # Database Setup def get_db(): # Using a context manager for the connection conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return conn def init_db(): with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() # Use parameterized queries/DDL cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, password_hash TEXT NOT NULL ) ''') cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS secrets ( username TEXT PRIMARY KEY, secret_value TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users (username) ) ''') conn.commit() init_db() # Pydantic Models with basic constraints to prevent resource exhaustion (DoS) class UserRegister(BaseModel): email: EmailStr username: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100) password: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=1024) class UserLogin(BaseModel): email: EmailStr password: str = Field(..., max_length=1024) class SecretSet(BaseModel): username: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100) secret: str = Field(..., max_length=10000) # Bound request size class TokenResponse(BaseModel): token: str message: str # Utility Functions def create_access_token(data: dict): to_encode = data.copy() expire = datetime.utcnow() + timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES) to_encode.update({"exp": expire}) # jwt.encode handles signature and algorithm return jwt.encode(to_encode, APP_SECRET, algorithm=ALGORITHM) def verify_token(credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security)): try: # Verify token signature and expiration payload = jwt.decode(credentials.credentials, APP_SECRET, algorithms=[ALGORITHM]) return payload except JWTError: # Return documented error status code raise HTTPException( status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid authentication token" ) # API Endpoints @app.post("/register", status_code=201) async def register(user: UserRegister): try: with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() # Salted hashing via passlib hashed_pw = pwd_context.hash(user.password) # Parameterized query to prevent SQL Injection cursor.execute( "INSERT INTO users (email, username, password_hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (user.email, user.username, hashed_pw) ) conn.commit() except sqlite3.IntegrityError: # Handle duplicate email/username as per schema raise HTTPException( status_code=400, detail="Email already in use or invalid data" ) except Exception: # Generic error to avoid leaking internal details raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Email already in use or invalid data") return {"message": "Registration successful"} @app.post("/login", response_model=TokenResponse) async def login(user: UserLogin): try: with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() # Parameterized query cursor.execute("SELECT password_hash, username FROM users WHERE email = ?", (user.email,)) row = cursor.fetchone() # Constant-time comparison is handled by passlib.verify if not row or not pwd_context.verify(user.password, row['password_hash']): raise HTTPException( status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid email or password" ) token = create_access_token(data={"sub": row['username']}) return {"token": token, "message": "Login successful"} except HTTPException: raise except Exception: raise HTTPException( status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid email or password" ) @app.post("/set_secret") async def set_secret(payload: SecretSet, token_data: dict = Depends(verify_token)): # Authorization: Ensure the caller owns the resource (username in token == username in body) # This prevents users from setting secrets for other users. if token_data.get("sub") != payload.username: raise HTTPException( status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid authentication token" ) try: with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() # Parameterized query to prevent SQL Injection cursor.execute( "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO secrets (username, secret_value) VALUES (?, ?)", (payload.username, payload.secret) ) conn.commit() except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error") return {"message": "Secret has been set successfully"} @app.get("/get_secret") async def get_secret(username: str, token_data: dict = Depends(verify_token)): # Authorization: Ensure the caller owns the resource they are trying to read if token_data.get("sub") != username: raise HTTPException( status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Invalid authentication token" ) try: with get_db() as conn: cursor = conn.cursor() # Parameterized query cursor.execute("SELECT secret_value FROM secrets WHERE username = ?", (username,)) row = cursor.fetchone() if row: return {"secret": row['secret_value']} else: # Return empty string if no secret exists, maintaining API behavior return {"secret": ""} except Exception: raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="Internal server error") if __name__ == "__main__": # Run on 0.0.0.0:5000 as requested uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
